title: x402 Error Taxonomy
description: Normative error codes for x402 v1 implementations. Every error response MUST include a machine-readable code from this taxonomy. Free-text messages are supplementary and MUST NOT be used for programmatic decisions.

code.description: Machine-readable error code. Stable across versions.

http_status.description: The HTTP status code this error is returned with.

retryable.description: Whether the client SHOULD retry the same request (possibly after backoff).

phase.description: Which phase of the x402 flow produced this error.
